subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should release owners backfill signed macOS assets and `appcast-beta.xml` for `v2026.5.22-beta.1`, or resolve this through the broader signed-beta distribution policy instead?
rationale: The source tree and live release state show the request is still unmet, but the remaining action depends on private release credentials and a policy choice because current docs allow beta builds without macOS app releases.

options.title: Resolve through the signed-beta policy PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower successor to define the future beta desktop rule, then cut a fresh beta with signed assets rather than silently backfilling an old beta train.

options.title: Backfill this beta
options.body: Run the private macOS validate/publish workflow for `v2026.5.22-beta.1` and publish a matching signed ZIP/DMG plus `appcast-beta.xml`.

options.title: Declare no macOS build for this beta
options.body: Record that this beta intentionally has no macOS desktop build and then close this tracker with that release decision.

recommendation.title: Resolve through the signed-beta policy PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower successor to define the future beta desktop rule, then cut a fresh beta with signed assets rather than silently backfilling an old beta train.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest release/appcast routing signal is recent stable appcast and macOS release workflow history on the affected surfaces.
